issue_request: FHIR-12320 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core workflow change request asking that Request.supportingInfo be 0..*.
initial_application: The Request logical model was introduced with Request.supportingInfo at 0..1 in commit cfe917ff48. Commit 83f1205cc1 changed the cardinality from 0..1 to 0..* on 2016-11-11, shortly after FHIR-12320 was created, although that commit subject listed other legacy tracker numbers rather than FHIR-12320 explicitly.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical model, making source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml build-scope source. FHIR-12253 requested the same cardinality and is closed Duplicate. Later issues FHIR-14000 and FHIR-25554 discuss codified or CodeableReference support for supportingInfo and were resolved no-change; neither reverses the 0..* cardinality. Exact-key Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the authoritative current source already satisfies the requested cardinality.
